title: Multimodal Models
summary: The multimodal_models module provides implementations for models that process and generate content across multiple modalities, such as combining vision and text or audio.

nodes.label: DiaForConditionalGeneration
nodes.title: DiaForConditionalGeneration
nodes.description: A model for conditional generation, specifically designed for audio outputs, leveraging a DiaModel for its core architecture and a dense layer for logits.

nodes.label: IdeficsForVisionText2Text
nodes.title: IdeficsForVisionText2Text
nodes.description: A multimodal model that integrates vision and text inputs to perform text generation tasks, utilizing an IdeficsModel and a decoupled linear layer for output.

nodes.label: Text Models
nodes.title: Text Models
nodes.description: This module contains various transformer-based models primarily designed for processing and generating text, covering a wide range of NLP tasks.

nodes.label: Vision Models
nodes.title: Vision Models
nodes.description: This module encompasses models specialized in computer vision tasks, including object detection, image segmentation, and image generation.

nodes.label: Audio Models
nodes.title: Audio Models
nodes.description: This module provides models focused on audio processing, such as speech recognition, audio classification, and speech-to-text/text-to-speech tasks.

groups.label: Core Multimodal Models
groups.title: Core Multimodal Models
groups.description: Central implementations for models that integrate and process multiple data modalities.
